svg.text: Apple M1 performance core at one glance. Every number is a knowledge base parameter; the glyph beside it is how well it is known.
rename, issue out of order, retire in order
shared by the P cluster or by the chip
3 cycles to a chase, 4 to an ALU
load and store uops take queue entries at issue
L1 to L2, 32 B per cycle each way
